style.vernacular: Swahili-influenced Comorian towns: the Moroni medina of narrow alleys with lime-plastered coral-stone houses with carved wooden doors beside a small harbour; elsewhere 1-3 storey concrete-block buildings in painted render (white, cream, pastel blue/green, ochre) with corrugated metal roofs, black volcanic basalt walls near Karthala, flat concrete slab roofs with rebar, palms and mango/breadfruit trees.
style.ornament: Carved wooden doors and lintels with Swahili/Arab geometric motifs, lime-plastered niches and arches (mihrab-style), slender round-section minarets added in the 20th century, black lava-stone wall bases, green and white mosque trim.
